summary_md: **Matthew ([@matthewabides](https://x.com/matthewabides/status/2115767287051374957))** open-sources the **queen-harness** crypto research harness: code classifies the question into one of 10 kinds and exposes only the needed functions, prefetches a token dossier, computes the verdict in code (worst check wins), and runs 44 functions over Solana RPC and other sources with any tool-calling model ([crawlnet/queen-harness](https://github.com/crawlnet/queen-harness), [queen-v6 weights](http://huggingface.co/Crawlnet/queen-v6)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - Crawlnet/queen-harness: The research harness behind the queen of crawlnet: a crypto research agent for Solana traders. Any model with tool calls, 44 functions, MIT.

relevance: Harness design pattern: code-routed tool subsets and code-made verdicts.
